units.source_text: “……这也是在哪儿读到过的事情……喏，最近不是有很多人离家出走吗？

en.t: ... I read about this somewhere too ... You know, lately, many people have been running away from home, haven't they?

units.source_text: ……谁都以为是生活环境恶劣造成的，其实并非仅仅这个原因呀……

en.t: ... Everyone thinks it is because their living conditions are bad, but actually that is not the only reason ...

units.source_text: 听说有个中等程度的农家，新购置了土地，新添置了机器，

en.t: I heard there was a middling farm household that had bought new land and added new machinery,

units.source_text: 经营也还马马虎虎过得去，谁知这家的大儿子突然离家出走了。

en.t: and the farm was getting by well enough, but then the eldest son of that family suddenly ran away from home.

units.source_text: 原本他是个老实巴交热心工作的青年，谁也搞不清是什么原因，

en.t: He had originally been an honest, hardworking young man, and no one could figure out what the reason was,

units.source_text: 连他父母亲也抱头苦思，不知是怎么回事。

en.t: even his parents racked their brains over it and still did not know what had happened.

units.source_text: 农村里人嘛，都爱面子，还有朋友间的应酬，

en.t: People in the countryside care about appearances, you know, and there are social obligations among friends too,

units.source_text: 连后嗣都离家出走，肯定有什么难言之隐吧……”

en.t: so if even the heir runs away from home, there must be some painful circumstance they cannot talk about ..."
